heading: 84-year-old veteran donated 207-acre llama ranch; now it is a sanctuary
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: In an inspiring act of philanthropy, Navy veteran Al Ellis has gifted his expansive ranch in Wyoming to a dedicated foundation. This sanctuary will cater to veterans and first responders, providing a serene environment for healing and family bonding. With the Boulder Crest Foundation’s specialized initiatives, the campus is anticipated to be operational by September 2027, transforming lives one family at a time.
